certification_scope.note: The certification holds for this scope only. Widen the topics, or admit Synergy to serving, and the review restarts: the builder drops exclusion_review_complete automatically when the build no longer matches this scope.

certification_evidence.verified_by: ppqviewer architect, 2026-09-15, sha256 prefixes recomputed from the seat's tree
certification_evidence.method: 17,323 flattened searchable text units from aqa_extraction_plus_calc.db opened read-only, matched against printed assessment wording; seven assessment pages carrying 45 or fewer native words rendered and read for the first time.

policy: Additive whole-parent exclusions supported by targeted visual review of current assessment snapshots. Apply alongside the broad assessment matcher. Shared-context variants are explicitly marked conservative; unmatched pages are not certified clear.

resolved_as_absent_from_corpus.test: 5. Forces and motion/1. Early test/Motion wk4 test 2025.pdf
items: Cyclist velocity-time graph, Y at 30 s and 5.4 m/s, Z at 70 s; distance between Y and Z
Aircraft distance-time graph reaching 12 000 m at 50 s
Aircraft decelerating at 0.14 m/s2 from 250 m/s to 68 m/s
resolved_as_absent_from_corpus.finding: Each item searched on its own printed signature against all 17,323 flattened text units. All returned zero. The word aircraft occurs in three parents corpus-wide, none of them a motion question. The served 2020 P2F Q04 bicycle graph was visually rejected on 10 September.
resolved_as_absent_from_corpus.conclusion: Absent from the corpus. A question the corpus does not contain cannot be served by it. Absence is evidence, not proof of origin: an older specification, another board or a published practice resource are all consistent with this.

limitations: This targeted review supplements, rather than replaces, the broader 201-document assessment scan.

Nine named current tests were snapshotted. Native text was ranked across every page/paragraph block; selected image-only pages and all embedded images of the 2025 resit and 2026 final forces DOCX were viewed. Seven further low-word-count pages were rendered in the 14 September closing pass.
The three DOCX tests' embedded images were inspected on 2026-09-10 and not re-inspected in the closing pass.
No generic shared phrase alone establishes source identity; weak matches for speed-of-sound recall, standard equations, and common answer instructions were not treated as confirmed sources.
A 2026 assessment must still be checked. The source-paper cutoff at 2026 does not make questions copied into a 2026 test safe.
The builder must apply whole-parent exclusions and the source-paper year cutoff independently.
The certification in certification_scope covers the two-topic, Trilogy-only input. It does not carry to a wider corpus.
